content:
Nina: Quick sync: we're seeing inconsistent retry + paging semantics across Python/TS/Go SDKs. Need decision on surface and transport independence.
Raj: My preference: make Retry a call-level opt-in/opt-out with sane client defaults, not a per-client global only. Easier to reason about for paginated calls.
Celia: Agree. Also we must decide whether paginated list calls auto-retry on transient failures mid-pagination. That trips up resume token semantics.
Nina: Proposal: default retries enabled for safe list/search ops but disabled for any endpoint that returns an opaque resume token. Users must explicitly pass retry options if they want auto-retry with resume.
Raj: Implementation idea: add "RetryOptions" to the common call options struct in all languages. Example TS: client.listFoos({}, {retry:{maxAttempts:3,backoffMs:150}}).
Celia: Python parity: client.list_foos(..., retry=Retry(max_attempts=3, base_delay=0.15)). Go parity: Add functional options to pass retry config.
Raj: Important: resume tokens are opaque. SDKs must not inspect or split tokens to implement retry. If a retry happens, the SDK should re-invoke the RPC with the provided token; it should not attempt to reconstruct state.
Nina: Transport differences (gRPC streaming vs HTTP long-poll) should be hidden; expose a unified iterator interface that yields checkpoint tokens and errors. The iterator can surface a transient error so callers can decide to resume with the last token.
Celia: For backoff policy, we should embed a shared default table in SDK templates (initial, multiplier, maxDelay, maxAttempts) to make behavior across languages predictable. Product can override via IDL annotations later.
Raj: Short-term: change generator templates to accept call-level RetryOptions + shared defaults. Long-term: add idempotency markers to our IDL and let generators set safer defaults per-RPC.
Nina: I'll open an INF ticket and a small RFC that covers migration path + tests. sdk-bot: Created INF-3401 - "SDK paging & retry surface harmonization".
Celia: I'll add a mock server test harness that injects drops at different offsets to validate resume+retry behavior.
Raj: Consensus captured: 1) call-level RetryOptions across SDKs; 2) defaults enabled only for safe non-resume lists; 3) resume tokens opaque and no hidden token-mangling; 4) shared backoff defaults in templates; 5) plan to migrate to IDL-driven defaults.
Nina: Thanks, will follow up with RFC link and timeline.
